source.stem:
A man stands by a railway track.
A train travelling at 40 m / s takes 2.0 s to pass the man.
What is the length of the train?

intelligence.enrichment: All liquids apply an upward force on immersed objects. When an object is fully or partially immersed in a liquid, it experiences an upward force equal to the weight of the liquid it displaces. object immersed in liquid -> liquid applies upward force -> object can feel lighter or move upward while Earth's pull still acts The learner correctly applies this rule: All liquids apply an upward force on immersed objects. When an object is fully or partially immersed in a liquid, it experiences an upward force equal to the weight of the liquid it displaces. Water removes gravity from immersed objects, so floating objects have no downward force on them.
